title: MaleTheme Duo #019 · 남 클래식 머슬·펄 화이트 글로시·소방관 테마 / 남 머슬 모델·글래스 스킨·뱀파이어 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright waterfall viewpoint with a wooden deck, a waist-high wooden railing, stone steps of normal height and lush green cliffs behind them, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Chinese man in his late 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, pearly white eyeshadow with a clear gloss lip and soft blush, smooth light skin with a warm golden undertone, a confident smirk, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in high ponytail, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a gold round bell, a lead small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a gold teardrop-shaped sinker, a lead miniature anvil, an iron pyramid-shaped lump, a copper cube-shaped block, a lead hammer head), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered silver necklaces. Extremely long coffin nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful, classically muscular man, far beyond any real person, in the shape of a Greek statue. Wide shoulders, a full defined chest, a clean six-pack abdomen, strong rounded arms, and muscular thighs and calves, balanced and proportionate from head to toe, powerful and enormous. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a red-and-yellow firefighter helmet with a clear visor pushed up, yellow reflective-striped suspenders running over his bare shoulders and chest, and a minimal glossy red T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel and a yellow reflective stripe, on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme silver cowboy boots with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Chinese man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful boy-group center idol face with neat sharp brows, a slim nose and glossy full lips, clean-shaven, glass-skin makeup with a faint shimmer on the cheekbones, smooth light skin with a warm golden undertone, a warm natural smile, natural soft black hair styled in a chin-length bob, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted topaz drop, and on the other ear a large silver hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on silver chains of different lengths (a lead round bell, a gold hammer head, a gold ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and four to six layered rose-gold necklaces. RIGHT Physique: An extraordinarily large and muscular man, far beyond any real person, built like a muscle model. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a long black cape lined in red silk, fastened at his neck and hanging open down his back, leaving the front of his body bare, and a minimal black satin T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
